lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple discrete high-luminance circular clusters (spots) are visible, primarily arranged in loosely defined vertical columns on the mid-to-upper lateral flank. Spot density decreases ventrally.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible, with circular blobs acting as nodes situated within or at the edges of these vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least three horizontal ridges (carinae) are visible running longitudinally along the flank, each defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient transitioning from highlights on the dorsal edge to shadows on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Several elongated teleost fish (likely remoras) are visible associated with the ventral surface and the base of the pectoral fin.
